use_case_summary: Primary product: conversational assistant for developer workflows (code completions, retrieval-augmented responses). Secondary: enterprise search + periodic batch embeddings for analytics. Need deterministic tail latency for paid offerings, and reranking for search quality. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity for predictable unit economics.
poc_plan: Phase 1 — Baseline characterization: model variants (7B, 13B, 70B) on candidate hardware; measure cold/warm latency and KV cache hit rates
Phase 2 — Load tests: 1,000 -> 5,000 concurrent requests ramped over 1 hour; measure p50/p95/p99 token latency and failure rate
Phase 3 — Soak test: 72-hour sustained workload with production traffic sample (60% chat, 25% embeddings, 15% reranking); track memory leaks, queue buildup, and degradation
Phase 4 — Failure modes and fallback: simulate node loss, region outage, and model-variant fallback policies; validate graceful degradation
Phase 5 — Cost/throughput tuning: evaluate batching, KV cache, quantization profiles; produce recommendations for reserved GPU planning
representative_prompts: Chat/sample: multi-turn developer assistant (avg 6 turns, 250 tokens/turn) — tests real-time latency and KV cache effectiveness
Code-assist: prompt that requires function calling and structured JSON output — checks deterministic structured outputs
Rerank: 100-candidate reranking with cross-attention scoring model — validates throughput for reranking endpoints
Embeddings: batch 10k docs -> measure tokens/sec and batching latency under different batch sizes
performance_targets: Chat P95 latency <= 120ms for 256-token decode (warm cache)
Throughput: sustain 2,000 chat requests/sec at 50 token average across dedicated pool
Embeddings throughput: 20k docs/hour per 8-GPU cluster (after batching optimizations)
Error rate < 0.1% during soak test; no unplanned restarts
reserved_gpu_plan: Initial recommended config: 8x A100 80GB for single-region Dedicated pool to meet mid-range latency targets; optional 16x H100 for higher-concurrency mode. Plan includes 20% headroom for autoscaling bursts. Migration path documented: start with smaller commit and increase after 72-hour soak validates stability.
sla_negotiation_points: Define latency SLOs by model family + token length bucket (clear p95/p99 metrics and measurement method)
Scheduled maintenance windows and expected notification lead times
Credits & remediation for below-SLO incidents (tiered by impact)
Data residency and audit log retention SLAs for compliance
Support response times for Sev1/Sev2 incidents during POC and production
